headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback to edge out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6, while the Minnesota Twins secured a 5-3 win over the Los Angeles Angels. In other news, the Chicago White Sox made a midseason trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, and several teams have made roster moves due to injuries.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with the Atlanta Braves placing Mike Yastrzemski on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins have also made several moves, transferring Anthony Banda to the 60-day injured list and placing Mick Abel on the same list. The Athletics have placed Nick Kurtz and Zack Gelof on the 10-day injured list, while the Milwaukee Brewers have placed Kyle Harrison on the 15-day injured list.

The Chicago White Sox have made a midseason trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins have also made a trade, acquiring RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Edge Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Yohan Ramírez earning the win and Mason Montgomery notching the save.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Angels in Thrilling 5-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-5 win over the Los Angeles Angels, with Royce Lewis leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves left fielder Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The move was made on July 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. This move comes as the White Sox continue to navigate the 2026 season.
